title: Average of a list
description: average(scores) should return the mean of a list of numbers. If the list is empty it should return 0.0 instead of failing.

bug.summary: The function always divides by len(scores), which raises ZeroDivisionError for an empty list.

tests.description: a mean that is not a whole number

hints.1: Think about the case where there are no scores at all. What does the description say should happen, and what does your function actually do?
hints.2: Look at the division on line {line}. What is `len(scores)` when the list is empty?
hints.3: Dividing by `len(scores)` fails when the list is empty, because the length is 0 and Python raises ZeroDivisionError. The function needs to deal with the empty case before it reaches the division.
